people.name: Squirrelthug
people.title: Host · Founder
people.bio: Started in Wrath of the Lich King, has been on every launch since, and hasn't missed a month since Shadowlands. Raids and pushes keys with Second Attempt, plays most of the roster as alts, and writes WoW addons on the side. Runs the show, the site, the Last Attempt community, and the pipeline behind all of it.
